CustomField.description: aiplatform.ModelsAPI modelName used for the second-model verification gate (Draft_Verify_Enabled__c). Deliberately a cheaper model than the drafting model - the gate only fires on cases that already reached a would-be draft. Blank falls back to the class default (sfdc_ai__DefaultOpenAIGPT4OmniMini). Point at the full drafting model if the cheaper judge proves unreliable.
CustomField.label: Draft Verify Model
